import asyncio


async def outer_break(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        if page.last:
            break


async def outer_return(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        if page.last:
            return


async def outer_sleep(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


async def outer_condition(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    while cursor:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        cursor = page.next


async def outer_true(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    while True:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        pass


async def outer_stream(pages, rows, save, load, cursor):
    async for page in pages:
        page = await load()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        pass
